description: Waze 5.24.5.0 (ARM64). Seven independent options: selectable map themes; selectable report icon packs; detailed report icons at normal sizes; local rank badge selector; unlock driver moods; Android Auto setup; adjustable Android Auto police alert distance. Adds a seventh independent patch for Android Auto police/enforcement heads-up distance. Set 50 to 10000 metres in Map display, defaulting to 1200 metres, with native read-back verification and an original-distance restore option. Real car alert timing is pending user testing.
